cells.title: Give each handoff attempt its own request id, detect a deduped run and write a handoff ledger row
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1, D2 and D3. Commit a0e1bf25a is the model for this seam (handoff_door.rs, sessions.rs run_handoff_send, set_gate.rs routing, registry_payload.json). (1) D1: build_request takes an attempt token; execute_handoff computes it once per call as the current wall-clock milliseconds in base 36 and the request id becomes bee-handoff-<session>-<suffix>-<attempt>. The task file name gets the same attempt token so two attempts never overwrite one file. run_handoff_send accepts --follow-up-of <run> (wins over the PASEO_AGENT_ID lookup; dispatch_argv then adds --follow-up-of <run> --handoff) and a repeatable or comma-separated --expect-merge <branch>; pass them into execute_handoff through new parameters. Update the existing tests in handoff_door.rs and feature_group.rs that pin the old exact request id so they assert the bee-handoff-<session>-<suffix>- prefix instead. (2) D2: after parse_dispatch_run_id, run <binary> runs show <run_id> (stdin null), parse runs[0].status and runs[0].created_at (RFC3339). If status is done or lost, or created_at is earlier than the attempt start, return a new HandoffOutcome::Deduped { run_id, status }. An unreadable or failed runs show keeps Sent. run_handoff_send and the feature start --handoff-task path map Deduped to the refusal text [handoff_deduped] run <id> was already <status>; nothing new was dispatched — rerun bee state handoff send, write no audit row, and do not release the session. Keep the decision logic in a pure function (status, created_at, attempt start) -> bool with unit tests. (3) D3: a new module verbs/handoff_ledger.rs owns the ledger: a typed struct HandoffLedgerRow { request_id, run_id, project_id, session_id, feature, sent_at, task_file, task_text, expects: Vec<Expectation>, follow_ups: Vec<FollowUp>, status: LedgerStatus } with Expectation::BranchMerged { branch } serialized as {kind: branch-merged, branch}, FollowUp { run_id, request_id, sent_at, reason }, LedgerStatus Open|Met|NeedsOwner serialized open|met|needs-owner. Functions: ledger_dir(main_root) = main_root/.bee/handoffs, write_row (atomic write, one file named <request_id>.json), read_open_rows(main_root), and branch_merged(main_root, branch) -> Option<bool> via git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> main (None when the branch does not exist). On every Sent outcome (both send and feature start paths) write a row: expects gets wt/<feature> when that branch exists and is not merged, plus each --expect-merge branch. Resolve main_root as the control plane main checkout, the same root probe_door uses. Register --follow-up-of and --expect-merge for state handoff send in registry_payload.json. No code comments.

cells.title: Refuse a leader turn end that asks the owner to open a session or run a step the agent can run
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D6 in the Stop hook. Add hooks/session_close/owner_ask_net.rs with a pure function owner_ask_match(text: &str) -> Option<&'static str> that lowercases the final assistant text of the turn and returns the matched phrase from a fixed list: English open a new session, start a new session, open a fresh session, start a fresh session, new chat, run /clear, type /clear, please run, you can run, you need to run, you should run, can you run, then run; Vietnamese mở session mới, mở một session mới, mở phiên mới, tạo session mới, bắt đầu session mới, mở chat mới, hãy chạy, anh chạy, bạn chạy, chị chạy, vui lòng chạy. Reuse last_turn_assistant_text / the turn-boundary helpers already in session_close (claims.rs) to get the final turn text from the transcript events the hook already reads (perf_events). In mod.rs, on the Stop event only, before advisory(): skip when payload stop_hook_active is true, when crate::hooks::herding_worker_marker_set() is true, or when no phrase matches. On a match call crate::verbs::handoff_door::probe_door(root) (only on a match, never otherwise). Door Present: emit encode_block with reason: bee turn-end refused: the reply asks the owner to <phrase>. The owner never opens sessions or re-runs steps the agent can run. Run it yourself: bee state handoff send --task "<owner request in their words; standing orders>" (add --follow-up-of <run> when a finished run left work undone), or bee state handoff check to dispatch the follow-up for a handed-off run; then end the turn with one line. Door Absent: push one advisory line naming the phrase and saying no waggledance door exists, so write .bee/HANDOFF.json per the handoff playbook; never block. The match must be phrase-level only on the final turn text, not on tool output. Add unit tests in the module for the matcher (each language, a negative case). No code comments.

with no door the Stop passes with one advisory line
a herding worker is never blocked
prohibitions: No waggledance process runs when no phrase matches

cells.title: Add bee state handoff check that dispatches a follow-up leader for a finished run with an unmet merge
cells.action:
Implement CONTEXT.md D4 and D5 on top of lsh-1's verbs/handoff_ledger.rs. (1) In handoff_ledger.rs add a pure decide(row, run_status, merged: &dyn Fn(&str)->Option) -> CheckVerdict { Pending, Met, FollowUp { unmet: Vec }, NeedsOwner { unmet } } (finished means status done or lost; a missing branch counts as unmet; 3 follow-ups already sent means NeedsOwner), and check_all(main_root, door, dispatch: bool) -> Vec that reads open rows, reads each run with runs show , applies decide, and on FollowUp writes a task file .bee/tmp/handoff-followup--.md (text: Follow-up of handoff run : it ended but these deliverables are unmet: branch is not merged into main. Finish them through the bee chain (worktree merge from main), then report. Original task: ), runs dispatch --project

--leader --follow-up-of --handoff --request-id bee-handoff-followup-- --task-file , appends the FollowUp, moves run_id to the new run and rewrites the row; Met and NeedsOwner rewrite status. A failed dispatch leaves the row open and reports the error. Door Absent or dispatch false: report only. (2) Add the verb bee state handoff check in sessions.rs (route handoff.check in set_gate.rs like handoff.send, register it in registry_payload.json with flags run, expect-merge, feature, no-dispatch, json): --run with --expect-merge registers an adopted row (request id adopted-, project from the door, feature from --feature or none, task_text from waggledance runs show task) before the walk; prints one line per row ([handoff_check] run : pending|met|follow-up sent run |needs-owner: |no door: ) and a JSON array with --json. (3) D5: in hooks/session_init.rs (SessionStart) and in hooks/session_close/mod.rs (Stop, after the lsh-3 net and only when it did not block), when crate::hooks::herding_worker_marker_set() is false and read_open_rows is non-empty, call check_all with dispatch true best-effort (errors to log_crash, never change the exit code) and add one line per follow-up sent or needs-owner row to the hook output. With no open row no waggledance process runs. No code comments.
